facts.business: Kay Power and Paper Limited manufactures Kraft paper varieties.

capacity_or_capex.item: Purchase of balancing machinery for capacity expansion
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Till completion of supply; ₹11.54 Cr executed in FY2024-25, ₹3.89 Cr in FY2025-26, remaining in subsequent years

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: fire incident causing inventory loss of Rs. 63.32 lakhs and equipment loss; insurance claim receivable of Rs. 86.27 lakhs recognised as virtually certain under Ind AS 37; claim remains unsettled as at balance sheet date.

key_risks: Fire incident at plant resulting in loss of inventory and equipment; insurance claim unsettled as at balance sheet date
Heavy losses suffered by the company; Chairman and Managing Director serving without salary since 2002
Decrease in median remuneration of employees by 50.92% in FY2026
Reduction in permanent employees from 49 to 45
